title: Hollow Sb nanocrystals confined in N, S Co-doped carbon nanofibers boosting sodium-ion transport for high-performance sodium-ion batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,386-394
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01268F, Paper
Qiushi Huang, Yejian Yu, Rujia Zou, Jinqi Zhu, Huifang Chen
We successfully synthesized hollow Sb nanocrystals encapsulated within N, S co-doped carbon nanofibers, thereby efficiently decreasing the Na+ diffusion barrier and markedly enhancing structural stability.
